description: Noise artifacts — the entropy floor and its seeded imitators.

noise_floor.description: The noise seam. Left: gradient (simplex) noise - the smooth seeded field procgen calls 'noise', the same every run, rewindable, ownable. Right: white noise - a fresh value per cell, structureless, the incompressible entropy floor. The left is a crank in a smoother coat; the right is real noise, and it is the one procgen never uses because a shapeless field builds no world.
noise_floor.name: Noise Floor
noise_floor.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for noise. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
